name: Human Physiology in Spaceflight
summary: What spaceflight does to the human body (bone, muscle, heart, brain, eyes, immunity) and the countermeasures that keep astronauts healthy.

topics.name: The five hazards of human spaceflight: radiation, isolation, distance, gravity, closed environments
Fluid shifts and cardiovascular deconditioning; orthostatic intolerance
Muscle atrophy and exercise countermeasures (ARED, treadmill, cycle)
Vestibular and sensorimotor adaptation; space motion sickness
Immune dysregulation and latent virus reactivation
Sleep, circadian disruption and fatigue in space
Behavioural health: isolation, confinement and crew dynamics
Artificial gravity and partial gravity (Moon and Mars)
Extravehicular activity physiology: suits, decompression and thermal load
Research platforms: ISS, analogues (bed rest, Antarctica, HERA) and twin studies
